data.label: Label releasing devices for scenes
data.main_users: Main users (manage edit rights in the card)
data.panel_users: Panel accounts (no edit right by default)
data.image_dir: Image library folder (inside the config folder)

data_description.label: Lights, covers, climate, switches, fans, media players and scenes with this label (on the entity or its device) can be used in scenes.
data_description.image_dir: An image named after an area id is the default image of that area.
data_description.house_favorite_slots: Empty: as many as per area.

all_off.title: "All off" per room
all_off.description: Choose a room. "All off" always switches off its released lights; the next page sets what it takes as well.

all_off_room.title: "All off" in {area}
all_off_room.description: Besides the released lights of the room, "all off" also takes the released devices chosen here.

data.music: Music (media players that are not TVs): playback stops
data.tv: TVs (media players of device class tv): switched off

template.title: Load template
template.description: Options and installer scenes from a JSON or YAML file. Installer scenes with the same key are replaced. {error}

error.outside_config: The file or folder must be inside the config folder.
error.invalid_template: The template could not be loaded.

broken_steps.title: Scene {scene} has missing parts
broken_steps.description: These parts of the scene no longer exist or are now in another room, and are skipped when it runs: {items}. Edit the scene in the card, restore the devices or move them back.

capture.name: Capture current state
capture.description: Takes over the current state of the devices into the scene, e.g. on a long press of a push button.

all_off.name: All off
all_off.description: Switches off the released lights of a room, and music, TVs or switches if set for that room.

run_favorite.name: Run favorite
run_favorite.description: Runs the scene that lies on a favorite slot of a room or of the house right now, e.g. from a push button. An empty slot runs nothing.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: The room of the slot; or set House.

house.name: House
house.description: A slot of the house instead of a room.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot, counted from 1 as in the card.

capture_failed.message: The state could not be captured: {error}
